name: knowbe4-mcp
description: Every KnowBe4 KMSAT reporting feature, plus a local SQLite store for the questions the console cannot answer.

knowbe4_api_key.title: KNOWBE4_API_KEY
knowbe4_api_key.description: Sets KNOWBE4_API_KEY for the KnowBe4 MCP server. Get a credential from https://developer.knowbe4.com/.

knowbe4_base_url.title: KnowBe4 API base URL
knowbe4_base_url.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from KNOWBE4_REGION. Set it only to point at a different host.

knowbe4_region.title: KNOWBE4_REGION
knowbe4_region.description: Sets KNOWBE4_REGION for the endpoint template variable {region}.

knowbe4_user_event_api_key.title: KnowBe4 User Event API key
knowbe4_user_event_api_key.description: Optional. The separate User Event API key (KnowBe4 User Event API Management Console > API key), used only by the events commands to push custom risk events. Sent only to the User Event API host for your region.

knowbe4_user_event_base_url.title: KnowBe4 User Event API base URL
knowbe4_user_event_base_url.description: Optional. Overrides the User Event API host the events commands use (default: the User Event API host for your KNOWBE4_REGION). Leave blank unless KnowBe4 gave you a different host.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile (optional)
printing_press_client_profile.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.

knowbe4_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
knowbe4_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides (events_create and events_delete, which still preview and send only with confirm: true).

knowbe4_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
knowbe4_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

knowbe4_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
knowbe4_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

knowbe4_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
knowbe4_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on KnowBe4 requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.
